title: ZTAEnforcementAction
description: Policy enforcement payload issued by ZTA Policy Administrator (Server 1) to SDN Controller (OS-Ken/Ryu) or fallback PEP.

decision.description: ZTA Policy Engine verdict translated into a concrete PEP action.

switch_dpid.description: Target OVS PEP OpenFlow Datapath ID.

match_mac.description: Source MAC address to match in OpenFlow L2/L3 drop or rate-limit rule.

match_ip.description: Source IPv4 address to match in OpenFlow rule.

vlan_id.description: VLAN scope of the enforcement rule.

ttl_seconds.description: OpenFlow hard_timeout in seconds (0 only for explicit ALLOW or RELEASE).

priority.description: OpenFlow rule priority (quarantine rules must outrank normal forwarding flows).

reason.description: Human-readable audit reason recorded to Wazuh SIEM.

alert_id.description: Correlating EdgeFLAlert UUID that triggered this enforcement.
